description: Fetch one known record by type and ID — case, suite, run, result, plan, defect, milestone, environment, shared_step, review, custom_field and more. Use it only when you already have the ID and want that one record; for several, anything filtered, or a loop over IDs, use qql_search — one search returns the whole page. Cost: one API call, 0.3-0.5s; ten in sequence measured 5.3s against 1.2s for one qql_search.

fields.description: Optional field projection — only return these top-level fields. Pass ["*"] for all fields.

include.description: Comma-separated list of related entities to include in the response. Cases and runs already request their external issue links by default ("external_issues" / "external_issue"); pass this only to override that.

name: qase_get
title: Get record
